_readme: Config for scripts/integration-liveness.sh — the credential liveness probe.
Copy to .integration-liveness.json (gitignored) and declare YOUR integrations.
With no config the probe exits 0 and does nothing.
Each entry under 'integrations' is one probe. 'kind' picks the mechanism:
http          GET a URL with a token pulled from the environment (or from
the install's env file). alive = ok_status (default [200]),
dead = dead_status (default [401,403]). Anything else is
INCONCLUSIVE, never dead — a 500 is not a revoked key.
Point it at an auth-ONLY endpoint (/user, /users/me). An
endpoint needing extra params can 400 on a LIVE key and
false-flag it dead.
command       Run a CLI. alive = rc 0 and no dead_patterns in stdout+stderr.
dead_patterns exist because some CLIs exit 0 while printing
'401 unauthorized'. Prefer a subcommand that hits the live API
over one that reads a local cache -- a cache says nothing about
whether the credential still works.
command_json  Run a CLI that prints a JSON status blob and assert on it.
'assert.true' lists keys that must be truthy. 'assert.list_contains'
asserts a list holds each wanted item as a substring (OAuth scopes
are full URLs, so 'calendar' matches '.../auth/calendar').
This is what catches the nastiest decay: token VALID but a scope
silently dropped at re-consent.
not_probed    Declared, never probed. Use for integrations reachable only from
an agent (MCP-only, no CLI). List them EXPLICITLY -- a manifest
that silently omits them implies coverage it does not have.
Shared optional fields: 'impacts' (what breaks when this dies — shown in the
alert), 'remediation' (the one-line fix, so you can act without digging),
'timeout' (seconds), 'enabled': false (skip without deleting the entry).
Secrets are NEVER stored here — only the NAME of the env var holding them.
token_env is read from the environment, falling back to the install's env file
(/etc/agent-os/agent-os.env, override with $AGENT_OS_ENV_FILE).

neon.remediation: rotate NEON_API_KEY in /etc/agent-os/agent-os.env (Neon console -> API keys)

example_cli.remediation: re-authenticate some-cli, or rotate its key
